pages.title: Power From Poultry
pages.text: Load it with $(l)Redstone Flux Chickens$(). Output in FE/t scales with how many birds are inside and with their stats, and the generator exports that energy straight to adjacent machines.$(br2)No fuel, no ash, no downtime as long as the chickens stay put.

pages.title: Tuning It
pages.text: The Roost Generator is the one machine with a whole upgrade family of its own. See $(l)RF Upgrades$() in the Upgrades and Tools category to push capacity, generation rate and output ratio well past the defaults.
